name: MLPerf Inference v6.0 official results database, summary_results.json (520 result rows)
notes: The v6.0 round (results announced 2026-04-01), the round in which H100/H200/B200/GB200/MI300X/MI325X/MI350X/MI355X all appear for the LLM benchmarks. Same has_power finding as v6.1: zero of 520 rows carry has_power=true. Unlike v6.1 the v6.0 file exposes a per-row 'Notes' free-text field, and that is where submitters put their declared power configuration - e.g. NVIDIA B200 systems carry the literal string 'B200 TGP 1000W'. This is the ONLY place in the MLPerf result set where a declared TGP is machine-visible for these models, and it exists only in v5.0/v5.1/v6.0 free text, never as a structured field and never in v6.1. Contains the only genuine power-capped LLM pair in the whole database: Dell_MangoBoost result 6.0-0033 'PowerEdge XE9785 (MI355X Power Cap 1000W)' against its own uncapped 6.0-0032 on the same chassis.
